items.title: Welcome to Callsign
items.body: Turn your Microsoft Flight Simulator flights into a real career — contracts, a fleet, crew, bases and a living economy. Fly the leg; Callsign runs the company around it.

items.title: The economy has teeth now
items.body: Your own trading moves market prices, contracts and routes are player-priced, loans are rated to your credit, and bases can house a maintenance shop and a fuel farm. Every number you touch pushes back.

items.title: Start on the Jobs board
items.body: Accept a contract, fly it in the sim, and settle it — your first payout, reputation and XP land the moment you park. Grades reward a clean, stabilized approach.
